confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful login from an unusual IP, followed by privilege escalation, bulk downloading of sensitive files across multiple departments, and an attempt to cover tracks by deleting authentication logs.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (194.180.48.99) outside normal working hours.
Successful unauthorized login from the suspicious IP (194.180.48.99) following the failed attempts.
Privilege escalation: the user elevated their account to an admin role.
Data exfiltration: bulk downloading of sensitive files across multiple departments (Executive, Finance, Shared/Runbooks, Sales, Legal, and Marketing).
Anti-forensics: deletion/truncation of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide activity.

gaps: Confirmation of whether the IP 194.180.48.99 is associated with a known VPN or malicious actor.
Verification of whether user_10 was actually performing emergency maintenance (though the log deletion and cross-department access make this unlikely).
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_10's account after a brute-force attempt from an unusual IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, performed a bulk download of sensitive data from nearly every department in the organization, and then attempted to cover their tracks by deleting the authentication logs.
